correctness.rationale: The exact \(10\times32\) evaluation matrix is reconstructed over \(\mathbb F_3\) and has rank \(10\). Even degree collapses the columns into \(16\) antipodal pairs. For a three-dimensional coefficient space \(U\), its projective zero columns span a subspace of \(U^\perp\), hence have rank at most \(7\). All \(11440\) nine-subsets have rank at least \(8\), while exactly \(750\) of the \(12870\) eight-subsets have rank \(7\). Each rank-\(7\) eight-subset has a unique three-dimensional annihilator and no ninth zero type, proving support \(16\) and the exact count \(750\). The verifier constructs \(1920\) distinct natural signed-permutation actions and checks the orbit sizes \(10,20,240,480\).

value.rationale: Example 4.6 is singled out by the primary article precisely because the standard footprint method fails there and the third generalized weight is obtained only computationally. The exact count of all 750 minimizers replaces an isolated minimum value by a complete extremal classification, while the four natural symmetry orbits reveal nontrivial internal geometry. This is a motivated finite invariant of the article's canonical counterexample to sharpness, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
